data.body: Resumed at current `origin/main` `070c54e6f0ff34577c3cb66632d57387f7bddf7d` (clean fast-forward from `25d1d683e55a`). The latest delivery-story review BLOCKED on G6 because Scope preservation relied on self-authored completion comments and the migration TSV checked only path structure. Remediation is now durable: all 11 delivery leaves record an executable comment-only diff guard, per-path `git diff --check`, and `make lint`; `dendritic-irksome-raven` now requires a separate non-author reviewer to produce a leaf-linked item-by-item before/after TSV for every constraint, consumer contract, and edited comment block. Exact-string equality is explicitly excluded so concise semantic rewording remains valid. Next gate: re-review the delivery story, then the epic, claim the valid chain, and execute `goldfilled-portly-dungbeetle`.
